title: Good option to plastic
text: Good option to plastic. I own several of these.  I will say that it keeps cold water (or other cold drinks) "cold" about 12 hours or so... it does start to be "less cold" after that.. But that's ok with me.  I like the size of these too.  Holds about 16 oz.  It is a true black color if that matters to you, not a charcoal gray.  I haven't used with any hot drinks so I cannot speak to that.  I will update with any new information, wear issues, or other helpful info.
